title: Formulation principles and synergistic effects of high-voltage electrolytes
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,3775-3818
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00826J, Review Article
Zewei Wei, Du Yuan, Xuedi Yuan, Yalin Zhang, Jianmin Ma, Suojiang Zhang, Haitao Zhang
A cross-scale evolution of formulation principles and synergistic effects of HVEs is illustrated stemming from the perspective of interatomic interactions, regulation of solvation structure, and further to the formulation of interphase.
